title: Collected Stories
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Wizards of the Coast short story anthologies)

paragraphs.text: Collected Stories is a series of Magic Story installments published by Wizards of the Coast in 2015 and 2016 in a eBook reader friendly format to make the plotlines of the game more accessible. There were no new collected stories released after November 2016.
The collected stories for Magic Origins and the prologue to Battle for Zendikar were the first two Collected Stories.
In preparation for the story arc of Oath of the Gatewatch the collected stories for Battle for Zendikar were published.
The collected stories of Oath of the Gatewatch were published in March 2016.
The Magic Story Shadows over Innistrad E-Book Collection was published in June 2016.
The Magic Story Eldritch Moon E-Book Collection was published in July 2016.
The Magic Story Conspiracy: Take the Crown E-Book Collection was published in September 2016.
The Magic Story Kaladesh E-Book Collection was published in November 2016.
